title: RAW_UNSCREENED: qoteedy-qokeedy ordnet Eigenschaft und Vorgang
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: In den sechs gebundenen Absätzen könnte qoteedy einen Zustand/Parameter desselben Inhaltskopfs markieren, während qokeedy den anschließenden Vorgang markiert; keine Bedeutung eines Einzelworts ist bestätigt.

design.scope_description: Only f77r.9-f77r.24, f80v.30-f80v.37, f85r1.1-f85r1.6 and their RF variants in the Luna packet.
design.mechanism: A shared qo-kernel carries one content participant; the eedy/teedy alternation is a compositional state-to-process contrast, with order carrying the relation.
design.unit: Exact adjacent and near-adjacent qoteedy, qoteey, qokeedy, qokedy occurrences at packet loci.
design.contrast: Ordered quality-to-process pairing versus qoteedy and qokeedy as unrelated high-frequency lexemes.
design.prediction: The state-to-process account predicts qoteedy/qokeedy or qoteedy/qokedy pairings and stable successor classes in f77r.11, f77r.14, f77r.17, f77r.20 and f85r1.2-.3; an unrelated-word account predicts no shared ordered consequence after exact-position controls.
design.shared_mechanism: The written q o kernel is reused for one content participant while terminal eedy/teedy selects state versus event relation.
concrete_observations: f77r.11 has qoteedy ... qokeedy; f77r.14 has qoteedy qokaiin ... qokeedy; f77r.17 begins qoteedy qoteedy and later qokeedy; f77r.20 has qokeedy ... qotedy.
f85r1.2 and .3 repeat otedy around qotedy/qokchdy, giving a second exposed paragraph with related ot/qot forms.
linked_consequences: If the mechanism holds, qoteedy-to-qokeedy order should be more stable than the reverse within the packet.
The same relation should predict which neighboring qok/qot form follows in both f77r and f85r1 without assigning an English gloss.
design.nearest_rival: qoteedy, qoteey and qokeedy are independent lexical words whose co-occurrence is topical or accidental.
design.distinguishing_observation: Write the exact pair/successor table before any gloss: a shared ordered transition must recur in at least two of the three paragraphs with the same direction and a declared non-pair control; a lexical-rival outcome is mixed or paragraph-specific.
assumption_costs: one shared qo participant across forms
safe local order as a relation
design.strongest_likely_failure: The pair occurs in only a few local arrangements and qotedy/qokeedy can be separated by position or paragraph, leaving no discriminator; the old 50 values remain unconfirmed.
